name: Zeitlind
desc: A girl who investigated her sister's disappearance in the sanatorium in Windrest Peak.

customize.text:
Raumhilda
Zeitlind's elder sister, who looked exactly like her. She disappeared in the sanatorium near

customize.name: Windrest Peak
customize.desc: An area in north Mondstadt, where Dornman Port is located. As one of the continent's major trade hubs, it welcomes a steady stream of merchant ships from various nations.

customize.text:
, and Zeitlind went to look for her.
Nihilita
Watcher of Nothingness, the Open-Eyed, who sent Zeitlind into the Temple of Space.

customize.name: Temple of Space
customize.desc: The site was designated "Segment-Domain Tau" by its former owner, who possessed neither aesthetic sense nor sentiment. Long ago, it stood upon the surface as a temple devoted to a goddess often invoked alongside "Time." In the wake of a disaster, it was lifted into the heavens, its presence and shadow hidden from sight. From then on, it served as a quiet watchtower over the world. The ruins left behind were eventually expanded and transformed into a sanatorium.

customize.text: To leave the Temple of Space, Zeitlind built a stairway from her memories, which disappeared entirely after she returned to Mondstadt.
